# STR2G – online HYROX training programs

> STR2G (Stronger Together) sells structured online HYROX training programs and 1:1 online HYROX coaching by coaches Ladislav Suchánek and Ria Suchánek Hrušovská (Prague, Czech Republic). Programs run in the Strivee app; plans, videos and support are in English (translation by arrangement). Website in 9 languages.

## Programs (prices in CZK)
- [HYROX Basic](https://str2g.com/programs/hyrox-basic/) – monthly plan, foundation, beginners: 750 / month
- [HYROX Competitor](https://str2g.com/programs/hyrox-competitor/) – monthly plan for regular racers: 960 / month
- [HYROX Pro Athlete](https://str2g.com/programs/hyrox-pro-athlete/) – top monthly tier: 1,350 / month
- [12-Week HYROX Race Prep](https://str2g.com/programs/12-week-hyrox-race-prep/): 2,100 one-time
- [12-Week HYROX Advanced](https://str2g.com/programs/12-week-hyrox-advanced/) – 12-week build for all levels, good for a first race: 1,900 one-time
- [8-Week HYROX Singles](https://str2g.com/programs/8-week-hyrox-singles/): 1,500 one-time
- [8-Week HYROX Doubles](https://str2g.com/programs/8-week-hyrox-doubles/): 1,700 one-time per athlete
- [Running for HYROX 2.0](https://str2g.com/programs/running-for-hyrox/) (12-week running block): 1,000 one-time
- [2-Week HYROX Taper 2.0](https://str2g.com/programs/hyrox-taper/): 550 one-time
- [HYROX Individual Program 1:1](https://str2g.com/online-hyrox-coach/) (online coaching): 3,500 / month

Each program also has a Czech page under https://str2g.com/cs/programy/.
